raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: python-rocksdb
  version: "0.7.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name | lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: aa692fbd06d8ed4ad641feee2970062fe01120e87b645a29403c71c628639e4f
  # Remove when packaging a maintained source release with Cython 3 support.
  patches:
    - patches/0001-support-cython-3.patch
    # The 0.7.0 sdist hard-codes GCC/Clang flags and the Unix bzip2 library
    # name. Remove when packaging a maintained release with native MSVC support.
    # https://github.com/twmht/python-rocksdb/issues/66
    - patches/0002-support-msvc.patch

build:
  number: 24
  script: python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython >=3
        - pip
        - python
        - setuptools >=25
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools >=25
    # Remove the direct pin when packaging a source compatible with the current
    # global RocksDB pin; the released bindings still target the RocksDB 6 API.
    - rocksdb 6.*
    - bzip2
    - cython >=3
    - lz4-c
    - snappy
    - zlib
    - zstd
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    - setuptools >=25

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - rocksdb
  - script:
      - python -c "import tempfile; import rocksdb; db = rocksdb.DB(tempfile.mkdtemp(), rocksdb.Options(create_if_missing=True)); db.put(b'key', b'value'); assert db.get(b'key') == b'value'"
      - pip check
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/twmht/python-rocksdb
  repository: https://github.com/twmht/python-rocksdb
  documentation: https://python-rocksdb.readthedocs.io
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Python bindings for RocksDB

extra:
  feedstock-name: python-rocksdb
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
    - maxibor
